Definition: to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue
BiblicalUsage: 1) to place, set, stand, set or station oneself, present oneself; 1a) (Hithpael) to station oneself, take one's stand, stand, present oneself, stand with someone
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
